description: Drive a fleet of headless agents through Marshal's MCP server: decompose a goal into independent tasks (implementation, research, review, audit, summarise), run them in parallel in isolated git worktrees, collect each run's product (diff or text), and integrate the good diffs. Use when you have multi-part work to delegate to worker agents (Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, Antigravity, Claude Code) instead of doing it all yourself. The engine is mechanism; this playbook is the judgment - decomposition, prompt-writing, and merge decisions live here.
